items.caption:
If you’re struggling at homemaking - it’s most likely because you need a reliable system to make things go smoothly.

I get it - multiple personalities, crazy sports schedules, teen driving hour logs, the dust building up on the ceiling fan, your calendar stacking appointments like Lincoln logs…

It gets better, this I’ve learned. But it also takes work, and some system building / implementation. 

It’s not enough to just *want it* - you have to actually DO it. 

If you’re new at this, take just one of these from my list (I love recommending the empty your sink one because there’s never a morning you wake up upset at a clean sink 😆💁‍♀️) and start working it into your schedule. 

What are some of your little routines around your home that help keep things running? 🏡👇👇👇

#routines #homemaking #tidyhome #cleaning #cleanwithme

items.caption:
Not skipping to Christmas just yet over here 🙅‍♀️😆 - because Autumn 🍂 is my favorite season.

I could be cliche and say how much I love the changing leaves and colors, the way the cold air feels in the morning, how much I don’t love the daylight savings change, blah blah. 💁‍♀️👋

And - those are all true. 😘

But I really love the sense of decorating my home for Fall, too.

This is one of my favorite fall crafts - takes minutes on the Cricut and you can save and reapply these cute cardstock  bats for years. 🦇 

I stick with black cardstock, but feel free to change yours to whatever color you like! They stick out really nice against my white range hood.

Comment “BATS” 🦇 and I’ll send you the full blog post with my design space 🔗, as well as the wall putty I use!

#fallcrafts #crafts #cricut #wallbats #iamanautumn

items.caption:
Have you seen these necklaces in the store? We saw a couple and I figured I could TOTALLY make one for our little cheerleader this year 😍🙋‍♀️

Here’s what I used: 
- EVA craft foam (2mm thick)
- loose leaf binder rings (.75 inch)
- plastic chain necklace (I had a gold and a purple one, I undid the rings and arranged them in a gold/purple/gold/purple pattern 😉)
- glue
- thin magnets to hold down the foam while I cut it

My laser cut super nice edges for me - I’m already thinking about what else we can make with foam! 

Laser: Nova Plus 35 60W from @thunderlaserusa 

Comment “⚡️⚡️⚡️”👇 for my settings and laser deets! 😍

items.caption:
The closer I get to YHWH, the more I realize that growth doesn’t always feel good.

Sometimes the pain comes from growing.

Sometimes it comes from growing apart.

And if I’m being transparent, some of what I’ve walked through over the last few years really shook my confidence.

It made me question myself in ways I hadn’t before. I replayed conversations. Wondered what I could have done differently. Questioned how people saw me and, at times, even let that affect how I saw myself.

And one of the hardest things I’m learning is that not everything needs my defense.

When you feel misunderstood, there’s such a strong urge to set the record straight. To explain your side. To confront. To demand answers. To make sure people know what really happened.

But Jesus already knows.

He saw the conversations I wasn’t in.
He saw the intentions behind the actions.
He saw what hurt.
He saw my own heart, too.
And He knows the whole story better than I ever could.

There is so much freedom in realizing I don’t have to chase down every misunderstanding or fight to control someone else’s version of me.

And slowly, I’m learning to rebuild my confidence somewhere much steadier - not in being liked, understood, included, or validated by everyone, but in knowing who I am in Christ.

I can keep walking. Keep growing. Keep asking God to refine my heart and trust Him with the rest.

Through all the twists and turns, I’m incredibly grateful for the people God has placed beside me - the ones who have loved me well, prayed for me, encouraged me, and reminded me who I am when I struggled to remember it myself.

Especially my husband, who has been my rock through all of it. 🤍

I’m still learning. Still growing. Still being humbled.

But I’m learning that whether I’m walking through the pain or celebrating the good, I’d rather be close to Jesus than understood by everyone.

He saw it.

And that’s enough for me. 🩷🙏

#YHWH #christianmom #JesusisLord❤️
